source_note: Android runtime/test source and build configuration match this commit. Later documentation and iPhone edits do not alter these measured APKs.

method.data: 5,154 real Ed25519-signed synthetic public reports with 500-codepoint notes and unique event IDs/nonces. Validate each before seeding in one background transaction. Near the 25 MiB logical signed-data budget; SQLite page/index/WAL overhead is additional.
method.measurements: One run: full map/history/forwarding queries, a page of eight inventory candidates, then concurrent history query and remote ingest. Timed with elapsedRealtimeNanos. No physical-device or radio claims.
method.reproduce: Build/install product and test APKs; adb shell am instrument -w -r -e class org.trailmesh.app.persistence.ExchangePerformanceInstrumentedTest -e mode benchmark org.trailmesh.app.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner

interpretation.full_queries: Signature/projection verification holds the transaction lock for about 12 seconds and delays concurrent ingest. This exceeds the 10-second encounter idle deadline. Retain cancellation/deadline checks and retry without false stored ACKs.
interpretation.bounded_inventory: A page of eight inventory candidates takes about 26 ms here. Exchange uses bounded inventory and indexed lookups by ID instead of full forwardable scans.
interpretation.integration_gate: Before map/session radio integration (#26/#27), measure physical targets and use bounded map/history pages or a reviewed verification snapshot that preserves integrity, clock tracking and committed outcomes.
limitations: One emulator run; no percentiles or physical-device guarantee.
Host load, JIT/GC, virtualization and colocated synthetic reports affect timing.
Storage/CPU evidence only; no radio, lifecycle or battery evidence.
